00048 FFTEngineInternal::FFTEngineInternal(const int fftSizeToUse) throw()
00049 :   fftSize(Bits::isPowerOf2(fftSizeToUse) ? fftSizeToUse : Bits::nextPowerOf2(fftSizeToUse)),
00050     fftSizeHalved(fftSize>>1),
00051     fftSizeBytes(fftSize * sizeof(float)),
00052     fftSizeHalvedBytes(fftSizeHalved * sizeof(float)),
00053     ifftScaling(1.f/(float)fftSize),
00054 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW
00055     transformBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize + 2, 1, false)),
00056 #else
00057     transformBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize, 1, false)),
00058 #endif
00059     transformBufferSamples(transformBuffer.getData()),
00060     fftWindow(Buffer::hannWindow(fftSize)),
00061     ifftWindow(fftWindow),
00062     fftWindowSamples(fftWindow.getData()),
00063     ifftWindowSamples(ifftWindow.getData()),
00064     fftWindowFactor(fftWindow.sum(0) / fftSize),
00065     windowingBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize, 1, false)),
00066     windowingBufferSamples(windowingBuffer.getData())
00067 {
00068     static int announced = 0;
00069     
00070     ugen_assert(fftSizeToUse == fftSize); // fftSizeToUse should be a power of 2
00071     
00072     transformBufferSplit.realp = transformBufferSamples;
00073     transformBufferSplit.imagp = transformBufferSamples + fftSizeHalved;
00074     
00075 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW
00076     if(!announced) printf("FFTEngine using FFTW\n"); announced = 1;
00077     fftwPlan = fftwf_plan_dft_r2c_1d(fftSize, transformBufferSamples, (fftwf_complex*) transformBufferSamples, FFTW_ESTIMATE);
00078     ifftwPlan = fftwf_plan_dft_c2r_1d(fftSize, (fftwf_complex*) transformBufferSamples, transformBufferSamples, FFTW_ESTIMATE);
00079 #elif defined(UGEN_FFTREAL)
00080     if(!announced) printf("FFTEngine using FFTReal\n"); announced = 1;
00081     fftReal = new FFTReal<float>(fftSize);
00082 #else
00083     if(!announced) printf("FFTEngine using vDSP\n"); announced = 1;
00084     fftSizeLog2 = 4;
00085     while((1 << fftSizeLog2) < fftSize)
00086         fftSizeLog2++;
00087     fftvDSP = create_fftsetup (fftSizeLog2, 0);
00088 #endif
00089 }

00091 FFTEngineInternal::~FFTEngineInternal()
00092 {
00093 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW
00094     fftwf_destroy_plan(fftwPlan);
00095     fftwf_destroy_plan(ifftwPlan);
00096 #elif defined(UGEN_FFTREAL)

00108 void FFTEngineInternal::fft(Buffer const& outputBuffer, 
00109                             Buffer const& inputBuffer, 
00110                             const bool applyWindow,
00111                             const int outputChannel,
00112                             const int inputChannel) throw()
00113 {
00114     if((outputBuffer.size() < fftSize) || (inputBuffer.size() < fftSize))
00115     {
00116         printf("FFTEngineInternal::fft() - buffer(s) too small\n");
00117         return;
00118     }
00119     
00120     DSPSplitComplex fftBuffer;
00121     fftBuffer.realp = Buffer(outputBuffer).getData(outputChannel);
00122     fftBuffer.imagp = fftBuffer.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00123     
00124     //fft(fftBuffer, inputBuffer.getDataReadOnly(inputChannel), applyWindow);
00125     fft(fftBuffer, inputBuffer.getData(inputChannel), applyWindow);
00126 }
00127  
00128 void FFTEngineInternal::fft(DSPSplitComplex& outputBuffer, const float* const inputBuffer, const bool applyWindow) throw()
00129 {       
00130     if(applyWindow)
00131     {
00132         int numSamples = fftSize;
00133         const float *inputSamples = inputBuffer;
00134         float *tempSamples = windowingBufferSamples;
00135         const float *windowSamples = this->fftWindowSamples;
00136         while(numSamples--)
00137         {
00138             *tempSamples++ = *inputSamples++ * *windowSamples++;
00139         }
00140         fft(outputBuffer, windowingBufferSamples);
00141     }
00142     else
00143         fft(outputBuffer, inputBuffer);
00144     
00145 }

00147 void FFTEngineInternal::ifft(Buffer const& outputBuffer, 
00148                              Buffer const& inputBuffer, 
00149                              const bool applyWindow, 
00150                              const bool applyScaling,
00151                              const int outputChannel,
00152                              const int inputChannel) throw()
00153 {
00154     if((outputBuffer.size() < fftSize) || (inputBuffer.size() < fftSize))
00155     {
00156         ugen_assertfalse; // buffer(s) too small
00157         return;
00158     }
00159     
00160     DSPSplitComplex fftBuffer;
00161     //fftBuffer.realp = (float*)inputBuffer.getDataReadOnly(inputChannel);
00162     fftBuffer.realp = (float*)inputBuffer.getData(inputChannel);
00163     fftBuffer.imagp = fftBuffer.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00164     
00165     ifft(Buffer(outputBuffer).getData(outputChannel), fftBuffer, applyWindow, applyScaling);
00166 }

00168 void FFTEngineInternal::ifft(float* const outputBuffer, DSPSplitComplex const& inputBuffer, const bool applyWindow, const bool applyScaling) throw()
00169 {
00170     ifft(outputBuffer, inputBuffer);
00171     
00172     if(applyWindow && applyScaling)
00173     {
00174         int numSamples = fftSize;
00175         float *outputSamples = outputBuffer;
00176         float *windowSamples = this->ifftWindowSamples;
00177         while(numSamples--)
00178         {
00179             *outputSamples++ *= *windowSamples++ * ifftScaling;
00180         }           
00181     }
00182     else if(applyWindow)
00183     {
00184         int numSamples = fftSize;
00185         float *outputSamples = outputBuffer;
00186         float *windowSamples = this->ifftWindowSamples;
00187         while(numSamples--)
00188         {
00189             *outputSamples++ *= *windowSamples++;
00190         }
00191     }
00192     else if(applyScaling)
00193     {
00194         int numSamples = fftSize;
00195         float *outputSamples = outputBuffer;
00196         while(numSamples--)
00197         {
00198             *outputSamples++ *= ifftScaling;
00199         }   
00200     }
00201 }

00203 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToRealImagRawSplit(Buffer const& raw) throw()
00204 {
00205     if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00206     { 
00207         ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00208         return Buffer();
00209     }
00210 
00211     Buffer splitBuffer;
00212     for(int i = 0; i < raw.getNumChannels(); i++)
00213     {
00214         splitBuffer <<= raw.getRegion(0, fftSizeHalved-1, i, i);
00215         splitBuffer <<= raw.getRegion(fftSizeHalved, fftSize-1, i, i);
00216     }
00217     
00218     return splitBuffer;
00219 }

00221 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToRealImagUnpacked(Buffer const& raw) throw()
00222 {
00223     if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00224     { 
00225         ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00226         return Buffer();
00227     }
00228     
00229     Buffer zeros(BufferSpec(1, raw.getNumChannels(), true));
00230     return (raw.getRegion(0, fftSizeHalved),zeros, raw.getRegion(fftSizeHalved+1, fftSize-1), zeros);
00231 }

00233 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToRealImagUnpacked(Buffer const& raw, const int firstBin, const int numBins) throw()
00234 {
00235     if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00236     { 
00237         ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00238         return Buffer();
00239     }
00240     
00241     Buffer unpacked = rawToRealImagUnpacked(raw);
00242     
00243     if(firstBin != 0 || (firstBin + numBins) < fftSizeHalved)
00244     {
00245         Buffer temp = unpacked;
00246         unpacked = temp.getRegion(firstBin, firstBin + numBins - 1);        
00247         unpacked = (unpacked, temp.getRegion(firstBin + fftSizeHalved + 1, firstBin + fftSizeHalved + numBins));
00248     }
00249     
00250     return unpacked;
00251 }
00252 
00253 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToRealImagUnpackedSplit(Buffer const& raw, const int firstBin, const int numBins) throw()
00254 {
00255     if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00256     { 
00257         ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00258         return Buffer();
00259     }
00260     
00261     ugen_assert(firstBin >= 0);
00262     ugen_assert(numBins > 0);
00263     
00264     Buffer splitBuffer;
00265     
00266     for(int i = 0; i < raw.getNumChannels(); i++)
00267     {
00268         splitBuffer <<= raw.getRegion(0, fftSizeHalved, i, i);
00269         splitBuffer <<= (B(0.f), raw.getRegion(fftSizeHalved+1, fftSize-1, i, i), B(0.f));
00270     }
00271     
00272     return splitBuffer.getRegion(firstBin, firstBin + numBins - 1);
00273 }

00275 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToMagnitudePhase(Buffer const& raw, 
00276                                               const int firstBin, 
00277                                               const int numBins, 
00278                                               const bool magnitudeAssumesWindowedFFT) throw()
00279 {
00280     if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00281     { 
00282         ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00283         return Buffer();
00284     }
00285     
00286     ugen_assert(firstBin >= 0);
00287     ugen_assert(numBins > 0);
00288     
00289     const int firstRealBin = firstBin;
00290     const int firstImagBin = firstBin + fftSizeHalved + 1;
00291     
00292     Buffer unpacked = rawToRealImagUnpacked(raw);
00293     
00294     Buffer real(unpacked.getRegion(firstRealBin, firstRealBin + numBins - 1));
00295     Buffer imag(unpacked.getRegion(firstImagBin, firstImagBin + numBins - 1));
00296     
00297     Buffer magnitude(hypot(imag, real));
00298     
00299     if(magnitudeAssumesWindowedFFT)
00300         magnitude = magnitude * (1.0 / (fftSizeHalved * fftWindowFactor));
00301     else
00302         magnitude = magnitude * (1.0 / fftSizeHalved);
00303     
00304     Buffer phase(atan2(imag, real));
00305     
00306     return (magnitude, phase);
00307 }

00309 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToMagnitudePhaseSplit(Buffer const& raw, 
00310                                                    const int firstBin, 
00311                                                    const int numBins, 
00312                                                    const bool magnitudeAssumesWindowedFFT) throw()
00313 {
00314     if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00315     { 
00316         ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00317         return Buffer();
00318     }
00319     
00320     ugen_assert(firstBin >= 0);
00321     ugen_assert(numBins > 0);
00322     
00323     const int firstRealBin = firstBin;
00324     const int firstImagBin = firstBin + fftSizeHalved + 1;
00325     
00326     Buffer unpacked = rawToRealImagUnpacked(raw);
00327     
00328     Buffer real(unpacked.getRegion(firstRealBin, firstRealBin + numBins - 1));
00329     Buffer imag(unpacked.getRegion(firstImagBin, firstImagBin + numBins - 1));
00330     
00331     Buffer magnitude(hypot(imag, real));
00332     
00333     if(magnitudeAssumesWindowedFFT)
00334         magnitude = magnitude * (1.0 / (fftSizeHalved * fftWindowFactor));
00335     else

00350 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToMagnitude(Buffer const& raw, 
00351                                          const int firstBin, 
00352                                          const int numBins,
00353                                          const bool magnitudeAssumesWindowedFFT) throw()
00354 {
00355     if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00356     {

00358         return Buffer();
00359     }
00360     
00361     ugen_assert(firstBin >= 0);
00362     ugen_assert(numBins > 0);
00363     
00364     const int firstRealBin = firstBin;
00365     const int firstImagBin = firstBin + fftSizeHalved + 1;
